reranked_evidence.snippet: ## Embassy of India, Poland. # Embassy of India, Poland Embassy of India. Diplomatic relations were established in 1954, leading to the opening of the Indian Embassy in Warsaw in 1957. The President of India, Smt. Pratibha Patil, visited Poland in April 2009, and Polish PM Donald Tusk paid a state visit to India in September 2010. Krzysztof Szczerski, Secretary of State and Chief of the Cabinet of the President of the Republic of Poland visited India in January 2019. Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi paid a historic visit to Poland in August 2024. Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs W.T. Bartoszewski visited India to participate in the 2025 Edition of the Raisina Dialogue held in New Delhi. Visit of Prime Minister to Poland: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi paid an official visit to Poland on 21-22 August 2024 on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between India and Poland.
